scripts.build: bun run build:api && bun run build:web
scripts.test: bun run --cwd apps/api test && bun run --cwd apps/web test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck
scripts.lint: biome check apps/api/src apps/api/test apps/web/src apps/web/vite.config.ts
scripts.format: biome format --write apps/api/src apps/api/test apps/web/src apps/web/vite.config.ts
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test
